_comment: Live deployments on X Layer (chain 196). The delegate address is what users point an EIP-7702 authorisation at, so it is a security-relevant constant: never change it without re-verifying the deployed bytecode against a fresh build of the same source.

create2._comment: Deployed through the canonical deterministic deployer, so the address is a pure function of the salt and the init code — anyone can recompute it from source and confirm nothing else was deployed here.

privileges._comment: Stated explicitly because it is the question anyone auditing this should ask first.
privileges.deployer_retains: nothing — the contract has no privileged role of any kind, so the wallet that paid for deployment has no more power over it than any other address

external._comment: Third-party addresses verified present on 196 by direct eth_getCode probe on 2026-08-07.
